questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospital reports more; Helen Newberry Joy Hospital is next at 140. About 22.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Helen Newberry Joy Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 4 Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospitals; Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital has the most, 270. About 5.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Baraga County Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks third of 4 Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospitals; Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital has the most, 270. About 5.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Munising Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 4 Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospitals; Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital has the most, 270. About 6.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 4 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: What percent of Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospital runs higher; Helen Newberry Joy Hospital is next at 44 percent. Traditional Medicare was 36 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 26 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Helen Newberry Joy Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospitals; Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital runs highest, 61 percent. Traditional Medicare was 27 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 17 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Baraga County Memorial Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions hospitals; Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital runs highest, 61 percent. Traditional Medicare was 34 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 3 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Helen Newberry Joy Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 2 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Michigan. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of Upper Peninsula Health Care Solutions's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Baraga County Memorial Hospital, Helen Newberry Joy Hospital, Munising Memorial Hospital and Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital.
